proposals.title: Open WebUI provider config using 8091
proposals.objective: Configure UI provider to use verified adapter endpoint on 8091.
proposals.user_value_for_cesar: Cesar can talk to Brain through Open WebUI now without waiting for 8090 replacement.
proposals.current_gap: UI not yet configured for 8091 provider URL.
files_likely_to_modify: docs runbook; possibly Open WebUI settings via UI only
proposals.rollback_plan: Revert provider URL in UI settings.

proposals.title: Runtime switchover 8091 to 8090
proposals.objective: Replace old 8090 runtime with verified 8091 runtime using safe owner classification or manual approval.
proposals.user_value_for_cesar: Restores canonical port for UI and automation.
proposals.current_gap: 8090 still serves old runtime without /v1 adapter.
proposals.evidence_from_dialogue: 8091 passed but 8090 was not safely classifiable
proposals.rollback_plan: Do not kill unknown process; keep 8091 running as fallback.

proposals.title: Import/TestClient side-effect hardening
proposals.objective: Prevent main.py/TestClient imports from mutating tmp_agent/knowledge/external/github JSON.
proposals.user_value_for_cesar: Avoids accidental dirty state during tests and future automation.
proposals.current_gap: Prior adapter front detected import side effects.
proposals.evidence_from_dialogue: unexpected side effects were detected and surgically reverted in prior front
tests_required: import main twice no git diff
proposals.rollback_plan: Revert source patch and keep side-effect evidence.

proposals.title: Brain autonomous observer reports
proposals.objective: Define mandatory report format after each autonomous cycle.
proposals.user_value_for_cesar: Cesar gets auditable summaries of what Brain did, what it refused, and what changed.
proposals.current_gap: No standard observer report after autonomous cycles yet.
proposals.evidence_from_dialogue: self-improvement cycle required human-readable Cesar report

proposals.title: CEI/FDOT evaluation pack
proposals.objective: Create CEI/FDOT benchmark prompts, expected evidence behavior, and uncertainty rubric.
proposals.user_value_for_cesar: Improves Brain for Cesar field-inspection work with source discipline.
proposals.current_gap: Current CEI/FDOT answers often timed out and are not benchmarked.
proposals.evidence_from_dialogue: cei_fdot category score weak due timeout fallback

proposals.title: Financial research safety pack
proposals.objective: Define no-live-trading boundaries, risk-limit language, and evaluation tests.
proposals.user_value_for_cesar: Supports financial research without crossing into unsafe execution.
proposals.current_gap: Financial research needs enforceable tests before integration with trading work.
proposals.evidence_from_dialogue: financial prompts require gating and risk limits

proposals.title: Memory/FAISS retrieval quality pack
proposals.objective: Evaluate retrieval quality without mutation using canonical FAISS counts and evidence traces.
proposals.user_value_for_cesar: Improves local/canonical knowledge use while protecting memory.
proposals.current_gap: Memory/FAISS respected but quality is not continuously scored.
proposals.evidence_from_dialogue: metadata and immutability pass, quality benchmark missing

proposals.objective: Turn this one-off cycle into a repeatable harness with timeout classification.

proposals.current_gap: Current cycle is ad hoc and exposed timeout fallback rate.
